AnnotationSelector.description: AnnotationSelector applies Kubernetes-style requirements to annotations.

matchExpressions.description: MatchExpressions supports membership and key-existence operators.

matchLabels.description: MatchLabels requires exact annotation key/value pairs.

ImagePolicy.description: ImagePolicy describes profile defaults for images referenced by Pods.

selection.description: Selection limits image discovery by Pod namespace, metadata, container type, and image reference.

ImageReferenceSpec.description: ImageReferenceSpec matches an image reference without conflating repository selection with tag selection.

registry.description: Registry is the registry host glob, for example docker.io or ghcr.io.

repository.description: Repository is the repository path glob without the registry or tag.

tags.description:
Tags accepts image tags matching at least one shell-style glob pattern.
An empty list accepts tagged and digest-pinned references.

ImageSelectionSpec.description: ImageSelectionSpec selects image references from Pods by namespace, name, labels, annotations, owners, and image reference.

annotationSelector.description:
AnnotationSelector filters objects by the same operators
and conjunction semantics as LabelSelector, applied to annotations.

containerTypes.description: ContainerTypes limits matches to regular containers, init containers, or both.

labelSelector.description: LabelSelector filters objects by Kubernetes label-selector semantics.

names.description:
Names limits objects to names matching shell-style globs.
A leading `!` excludes matching names; an empty list matches every name.
Quote values beginning with `!` in YAML because `!` otherwise starts a YAML tag.

namespaces.description:
Namespaces limits objects to namespace names matching shell-style globs.
A leading `!` excludes matching namespaces; an empty list matches every namespace.
Quote values beginning with `!` in YAML because `!` otherwise starts a YAML tag.

owners.description:
Owners selects objects in the ownerReference chain of a selected Pod.
A Pod is included only when at least one owner matches all configured owner filters.
Use Resources to distinguish Deployments, DaemonSets, StatefulSets, Jobs, and other Kubernetes owner objects.

references.description:
References selects images by registry, repository, and optional tag globs.
Multiple entries are combined with OR semantics.

MatchSpec.description: MatchSpec selects objects by resource identity and metadata.

description.description: Description is a concise user-facing explanation of the profile's purpose.
examples: Clean export suitable for sharing or redeployment

name.description: Name is the lowercase alias used with --profile and profile commands.

PVCPolicy.description: PVCPolicy describes profile defaults for persistent-volume claim data.

selection.description: Selection limits PVC data by namespace, name, and Kubernetes metadata.

PVCSelectionSpec.description: PVCSelectionSpec selects PVC data by namespace, name, labels, and annotations.

Profile.description: Profile is the complete YAML policy consumed by kube-dump.

apiVersion.description: APIVersion identifies the profile contract version.

images.description:
Images defines optional Pod metadata, container, and image-reference filters.
An empty selection includes every image allowed by runtime flags.

kind.description: Kind identifies the document as a kube-dump profile.

metadata.description: Metadata gives the profile its catalog name and user-facing description.

pvc.description:
PVC defines optional namespace, metadata, and name filters for PVC data.
An empty selection includes every PVC allowed by runtime flags.

resources.description:
Resources defines which Kubernetes API objects are collected
and how they are normalized before serialization.

ResourcePolicy.description: ResourcePolicy describes API-object selection and ordered object transforms.

omitEmpty.description:
OmitEmpty removes null values and empty maps or lists from resource objects before serialization.
Zero values, false values, and empty strings are kept.

rules.description:
Rules are evaluated in declaration order after selection.
When omitted or empty, no fields are removed or encrypted.

selection.description:
Selection defines the initial set of API objects admitted by the profile.
When omitted or empty, all discovered resources are included.

ResourceSelectionSpec.description: ResourceSelectionSpec selects Kubernetes API objects by resource, namespace, name, labels, and annotations before rule processing.

annotationSelector.description:
AnnotationSelector filters objects by the same operators
and conjunction semantics as LabelSelector, applied to annotations.

labelSelector.description: LabelSelector filters objects by Kubernetes label-selector semantics.

names.description:
Names limits objects to names matching shell-style globs.
A leading `!` excludes matching names; an empty list matches every name.
Quote values beginning with `!` in YAML because `!` otherwise starts a YAML tag.

namespaces.description:
Namespaces limits objects to namespace names matching shell-style globs.
A leading `!` excludes matching namespaces; an empty list matches every namespace.
Quote values beginning with `!` in YAML because `!` otherwise starts a YAML tag.

resources.description:
Resources is an ordered list of `group/version/resource[:name]` expressions.
A leading `!` excludes matching resources or a specific object name.
Quote values beginning with `!` in YAML because `!` otherwise starts a YAML tag.

RuleSpec.description: RuleSpec describes one ordered transformation applied to matching objects.

encrypt.description:
Encrypt lists dot/bracket field paths protected when runtime encryption is configured.
Without recipients or an AES-SIV keyring, the selected fields remain plaintext.

match.description: Match selects the objects affected by this rule; all populated match fields must pass.

name.description: Name labels the rule in validation errors and diagnostics.

remove.description: Remove lists dot/bracket field paths deleted before serialization.

Selector.description: Selector is a Kubernetes-style conjunction of label requirements.

matchExpressions.description: MatchExpressions supports membership and key-existence operators.

SelectorRequirement.description: SelectorRequirement is one operator-based label or annotation requirement.

key.description: Key is the label or annotation key to test.

operator.description: Operator determines how Key and Values are evaluated.

values.description: Values contains operands for In and NotIn operators.
